title: Revision rota: Al-Layl to Al-Fajr: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Summer 1: Al-Baqarah 285 to 286; madd laazim and 'aarid
source: Written for quran/y4 lesson 39 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Revision rota rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 39. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ (١) وَأَنتَ حِلٌّۢ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ (٢) وَوَالِدٍۢ وَمَا وَلَدَ (٣) لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِى كَبَدٍ (٤) أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌۭ (٥) يَقُولُ أَهْلَكْتُ مَالًۭا لُّبَدًا (٦) أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّمْ يَرَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ (٧) أَلَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ عَيْنَيْنِ (٨) وَلِسَانًۭا وَشَفَتَيْنِ (٩) وَهَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلنَّجْدَيْنِ (١٠)

keywords.def: a plan of which surahs to revise each day

questions.q: Chain recitation: each pupil recites one ayah of Ash-Shams.
Rota: today's group recites two surahs of 92 to 89 to the teacher. Everyone else: 3-3-link their weakest ayat and plan the week's rota.
Extend: recite Al-Fajr 19 to 30 to a partner.
Which surah begins with an oath by the dawn?
Think again: We learned Al-Layl in Spring. What is the best way to keep it strong while learning new ayat?
questions.a: A daily rota: a few old surahs every day, so each is recited at least once a week.
